//: Standalone TS config for ts-jest ONLY. It deliberately does NOT extend expo/tsconfig.base: the app build uses module=preserve + moduleResolution=bundler + customConditions=[react-native], which are incompatible with the CommonJS output Jest needs. The unit tests here cover pure, node-runnable logic (api/adapter, api/client, i18n parity) with zero React Native imports, so a plain node/commonjs compile is correct and keeps the real tsconfig.json untouched.
